title: Diegetic Lattice Stress Fractures & Radiant Crucible Bloom: Pure in-world visual feedback system replacing external state prompts with progressive glowing obsidian fractures, dynamic refractive ripples along partition lines, and prismatic heat distortion over contested triad corridors.
author_role: Principal Client & UI Architect (Canvas 2D rendering, HUD overlays, visual feedback)
summary: Projects real-time obsidian stress fractures, chromatic refractive ripples on dividers, and heat bloom over contested collinear vectors without HUD overlays.
technical_specification: Read `state.world.sectors[n].fractureLevel` and `state.world.contestedLines`. For each divider segment, render jagged procedural obsidian fissures using cached seeded noise offsets scaled by `fractureLevel * 2.8px`. Where `contestedLines.length > 0`, calculate triad corridor bounding box and draw an additive dual-pass radial gradient (`rgba(255,190,40,0.18)` core to `rgba(7,9,19,0.0)`) modulated by `Math.sin(state.world.time * 6 + lineIdx)`. Inscribe active shockwave rings via Canvas `arc()` with `globalCompositeOperation = 'screen'` and dynamic blur stroke (`lineWidth = (1 - age/maxLife) * 6`), eliminating text-based battle telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Contested triad corridors cast dynamic, pulsing refractive light across tiles with zero planar UI rectangles or floating text banners.
Dividers progressively display jagged, glowing fissures as repeated kinetic strikes land on adjacent sectors.
